sentence: This project builds a framework that partitions large quantum circuits into smaller subcircuits and runs them on both quantum and classical computing resources.
This project secures laboratory equipment, including microscopes and thermocyclers, for undergraduate courses in molecular biology and cell biology.
This project designs a protection framework that detects and reduces coordinated cyberattacks on electricity market retailers, and tests it on a lab-scale smart microgrid.
This project develops mathematics to explain when algorithms can navigate complex landscapes efficiently, and when intrinsic barriers stop them.
This project uses mathematics to study the ghost effect in heat conduction, plasma in a tokamak-like geometry, naked singularity stability, and fluid contact lines.
This project backs a conference where researchers share work on Arabidopsis thaliana, a plant whose biology can be applied to crop species.
This project uses scanning tunneling microscopy to image how electrons behave in two-dimensional devices made from single-layer materials in strong magnetic fields.
This project tries to find out how certain proteins, including a bacterial protein, make actin filaments grow from their pointed ends.
This project looks for covert timing channels in real-time schedulers and builds ways to detect, measure and reduce them.
This project screens insects preserved in a museum for phytoplasmas, a group of plant-parasitic bacteria, to uncover their diversity and evolutionary relationships.
This project builds models and machine-learning tools to explain how microbes in biological soil crusts evolve and persist when rainfall and other conditions vary.
This project tries to find the genes of mosquitoes and gut bacteria that control how gut microbiota assemble in the mosquito Aedes aegypti.
This project uses real outage data and deep learning to study how cascading failures spread through power systems and how to prevent and stop them.
This project studies how bats and the insects they eat relate to shrubs replacing grasses in a desert.
